title: Udemy Alternative for Indian Instructors (2026): 5 Options
description: A fair guide for Indian instructors weighing Udemy against their own academy: what Udemy is good at, rupee platforms with UPI checkout, prices checked, and using both.
og_description: Udemy, AllCoaching, Graphy, Learnyst and Exly compared for Indian instructors, with every price from the official site (checked 24 Oct 2026), what we could not verify about Udemy, and when to keep Udemy alongside your own academy.
h1: Udemy Alternative for Indian Instructors (2026): Your Own Academy, With or Without Udemy
dek: A fair guide for Indian instructors deciding whether to stay on Udemy, build their own academy, or run both, with every platform price taken from the official site and dated, and an honest note on what we could not verify.
cover_alt: Looking for a Udemy alternative: Udemy, Graphy, Learnyst, Exly and AllCoaching compared for Indian instructors, prices checked on 24 Oct 2026
audience: Indian instructors and educators who teach on Udemy or are deciding whether to build their own academy
intro: The best Udemy alternative for an Indian instructor is usually not a replacement but a second home: your own academy, with your own website, app, prices and student list, run alongside Udemy's global marketplace. For that academy, AllCoaching fits instructors who want their own domain, their own Android app (iOS app on Pro and Scale) and UPI checkout in rupees, set up without a sales call. Learnyst fits test-heavy exam academies, Exly fits coaches selling sessions with automation, and Graphy fits creators with an existing audience.

We are AllCoaching, so read this knowing who wrote it. Every platform price below comes from that company's own pricing page, with the link and the date we checked it, and we say plainly where another option, including staying on Udemy, fits better than ours.

Udemy is different from the others: it is a marketplace, not software you buy. Publishing is not a paid plan, and what an instructor earns is set by Udemy's instructor terms. We tried to check Udemy's official revenue-share page on 24 Oct 2026 and could not retrieve it, so this guide does not state a percentage. Read it on Udemy's support site before you decide.
takeaways: Udemy is a global course marketplace where instructors publish courses to Udemy's existing learners; publishing is not a paid plan.
Udemy's instructor revenue share could not be verified on 24 Oct 2026 (its official page did not load for us), so we do not quote a percentage; check it on Udemy's support site.
Your own academy gives you your own price, brand and student list; a marketplace gives you its audience. Many instructors use both.

AllCoaching starts at ₹6,999 a year plus a 10% fee on sales (Starter), with Growth ₹12,999 + 7.5%, Pro ₹24,999 + 5% and Scale ₹99,999 + 0%; GST extra, 14-day free trial with no card, your own domain and Android app (iOS app on Pro and Scale) on every plan.
Exly Starter charges no yearly fee and 10% commission, so it costs less than AllCoaching up to about ₹5 lakh of sales a year, before its app add-on (from ₹60,000 a year).
Learnyst publishes ₹10,000 a year + 10% (Launcher) and 0%-fee plans from ₹8,099 a month billed annually; AllCoaching costs less up to about ₹14.4 lakh of sales a year.
You do not have to leave Udemy to start: launch your academy for Indian students, keep Udemy for global reach, and compare after a few batches.

sections.h2: The short answer: keep the reach, own the relationship
sections.html:
Udemy and your own academy do different jobs. Udemy brings learners who are already shopping on Udemy. Your own academy is where students who know your name buy directly from you, at your price, and stay in your student list. Pick by what you need next.

{{fig:verdict|Which Udemy alternative to choose as an Indian instructor: own academy with your app and UPI checkout, AllCoaching; mostly mock tests, Learnyst; sessions and webinars with automation, Exly; global reach with no audience yet, stay on Udemy|Pick the row that sounds like you. Many instructors end up with two rows: Udemy plus their own academy.}}

The next sections show how we compared the options, what Udemy is good at, and what each own-academy platform costs.

sections.h2: How we compared Udemy and the alternatives
sections.html:
Because Udemy is a marketplace and the others are platforms you pay for, we compared the instructor's options rather than features alone. We looked at five things.

  1. How you earn: a marketplace's instructor terms, or a published plan price plus fee on sales.
  2. Who sets the price students pay.
  3. What you own: your brand, domain, app listing and student contact list.
  4. Checkout for Indian students: rupee pricing and UPI.
  5. Where students come from: the platform's audience, or your own YouTube, Instagram and WhatsApp.

Platform prices come only from each company's own pricing page. For Udemy we used only official Udemy pages; where they could not be retrieved, we say so instead of repeating figures from other websites.

Disclosure: AllCoaching publishes this guide. Competitor figures link to their official pages and carry the date we checked them (24 Oct 2026). Prices and terms change; check the source before you decide. If you spot an error, write to contact@allcoaching.in and we will correct it.

sections.h2: Why Indian instructors look beyond Udemy
sections.html:
Udemy works, and for many instructors it is where the first sale happens. Instructors usually start looking beyond it once they have some audience of their own.

What Udemy does well

Udemy is a global course marketplace where instructors publish courses to Udemy's existing learner base.[1] That is its real strength: a new instructor with expertise but no following can put a course in front of buyers without building an audience first. No software bill, no website to run, no payment setup.

1. Wanting your own price

On your own academy, you decide what a course costs and when to offer a discount, whether that is ₹499 for an SSC maths crash course or ₹4,999 for a full-year batch. On a marketplace, pricing works within the marketplace's rules. Read Udemy's own pricing and promotions policy for instructors so you know exactly how it applies to your courses. Our guide on how to price online courses in India covers rupee pricing.

2. Wanting to teach the same students again

A teaching business grows on repeat students: the learner who took your spoken-English basics comes back for interview practice. Check what student information Udemy's instructor terms let you receive and how you may contact learners. On your own academy, the student list is yours and you can export it.

{{q:If Udemy brings me students, why does owning them matter?|Because a single sale is not a business. When students buy from your own academy, you can tell them about your next batch, test series or live class directly. Udemy can still bring new learners; your academy keeps the ones who already trust you.}}

3. Selling to Indian students in rupees

Many Indian students and parents pay by UPI and think in rupees. An academy with rupee prices and UPI checkout, on an app with your name on it, fits that buyer. Our guide to the best UPI payment gateway for online courses explains why the checkout matters.

{{fig:before-after|Before and after: courses as one listing among many, prices set within marketplace rules and the question of reaching past students, compared with one academy login with your own website, app, prices, live classes and UPI checkout|The goal is not to leave reach behind. It is to have a home of your own as well.}}

sections.h2: 5 options for Indian instructors, compared fairly
sections.html:
Here is each option as its own company describes it, with the published price, what to check, and who it suits best. Staying on Udemy is included, because for many instructors it remains part of the answer.

Our platform · disclosure

1. AllCoaching

Good at
An academy you build yourself, like Shopify for coaching: sign up, choose a plan, upload your course, connect your domain and start selling. Website on your own domain, your own Android app (iOS app on Pro and Scale), courses, tests, PDF notes, unlimited live classes (YouTube Live, Zoom or the built-in room), UPI or card checkout with automatic Razorpay payouts, and a student list you can export.
Published price
Starter ₹6,999/yr + 10% on sales, Growth ₹12,999/yr + 7.5%, Pro ₹24,999/yr + 5%, Scale ₹99,999/yr + 0%; GST extra. Pricing[5]
Free trial
14 days, no card needed.
Check
Finding students is mostly your job; AllCoaching also lists your courses on its marketplace app, but that is a supporting extra, not a replacement for Udemy's global audience.
Best for
Instructors with some audience on YouTube, Instagram or WhatsApp who want their own brand and rupee checkout.

2. Graphy

Good at
An all-in-one platform for creators and coaches: website builder, branded apps, digital products and AI sales agents, to "launch, scale, and automate your online teaching business".
Published price
Graphy publishes plans on graphy.com/pricing, but prices are shown by country and we could not confirm the Indian rupee plans on 24 Oct 2026; check the page from India.[4]
Free trial
14 days.
Check
The rupee price of each plan, the fee per sale, and which plan includes the iOS app.
Best for
Creators selling to their own YouTube or Instagram audience.

3. Learnyst

Good at
Courses, mock tests and live classes with content protection and test series; it says it gives you the "features required to market and sell your content online".
Published price
Launcher ₹10,000/yr + 10% of sales; Professional ₹8,999/month (₹8,099/month billed annually) with 0% transaction fees; higher plans up to ₹49,999/month; taxes extra.[2]
Free trial
Not stated as a trial; buttons say "Get started for free".
Check
Its page says apps are published under Learnyst's developer account, and a branded Android app starts from Premium (₹14,999/month).
Best for
Exam-prep instructors whose main product is mock tests.

4. Exly

Good at
Storefront, payments, CRM and WhatsApp and email automation for coaches selling courses, consultations and digital products; it calls itself "an all-in-one solution to all things business".
Published price
Starter: no yearly fee + 10% commission; Pro ₹30,000/yr + 6%; Premium ₹1,08,000/yr + 3%. Add-ons include a mobile app (iOS and Android) from ₹60,000/yr and a custom website from ₹60,000/yr.[3]
Free trial
Not stated on the pricing page.
Check
GST treatment is not stated; price the add-ons you need, especially the app.
Best for
Instructors who also sell 1:1 sessions and workshops and want automation built in.

5. Stay on Udemy

Good at
A global marketplace with its own learners, so a course can find buyers without your own audience.
Published price
Publishing is not a paid plan. The instructor revenue share is set by Udemy's terms; its official revenue-share page could not be retrieved on 24 Oct 2026, so we do not quote a figure.[1]
Free trial
Not applicable.
Check
Read Udemy's instructor revenue share, pricing and promotions rules, and what student information you receive.
Best for
New instructors without an audience, and anyone selling to learners worldwide.

sections.h2: What your own academy costs as you grow
sections.html:
Udemy cannot be put on a cost chart, because it has no plan price and we could not verify its revenue share. What you can compare is the cost of your own academy on each platform. The chart adds each published rupee plan to its published fee at six sales levels and picks the lowest-cost plan at each level.

{{fig:cost|Total yearly cost at ₹50,000 to ₹15 lakh of sales from published rupee prices for AllCoaching, Learnyst and Exly|Before GST. Exly's line is plan price plus commission only, without its app or custom-website add-ons.}} {{cost_table}}

The honest reading: on plan price and commission alone, Exly Starter costs less than AllCoaching up to about ₹5 lakh of sales a year, because it has no yearly fee; above that, AllCoaching Pro costs less. Add Exly's app add-on (from ₹60,000 a year) and Exly Starter costs at least ₹70,000 at ₹1 lakh of sales, against ₹16,999 on AllCoaching Starter. Learnyst costs more than AllCoaching up to about ₹14.4 lakh of sales, then its 0%-fee Professional plan (about ₹97,000 a year billed annually) is lower.

To compare with Udemy, take your actual Udemy earnings statement and set it next to these totals at the same sales level. Use our plan finder to run your own numbers.

sections.h2: Udemy, your own academy, or both?
sections.html:
New instructor with no audience yet

Udemy's built-in learners are a real head start. Publish there, and start collecting an audience on YouTube or Instagram at the same time. Our guide on getting your first 500 students covers that early phase.

Instructor with a YouTube or Instagram following

Send your own audience to your own academy, where you set the price and keep the student list. Keep Udemy for learners who find you there. See how to earn from a YouTube teaching channel with your own app.

Exam educator teaching Indian students (SSC, banking, NEET, CA, UPSC)

Your students pay in rupees, often by UPI, and want live classes, tests and notes for a specific exam. An academy with your own app fits this best. See how to sell courses online in India.

Skill instructor selling worldwide (coding, design, marketing)

Keep Udemy for global buyers. Add your own academy for Indian students and for your most loyal learners, under your own name; see building a personal brand as an educator.

sections.h2: How to start your own academy without losing Udemy
sections.html:
You do not need to delete anything. The safe path is to add your own academy beside Udemy, and let the numbers decide how much moves over.

{{fig:switch|Four steps to add your own academy beside Udemy: build your academy, keep Udemy running, send your own audience to your academy, compare after a few batches|Nobody loses access, and you keep both sources of students.}} {{steps}}

If you later move fully from another platform, the checklist in how to switch coaching apps without losing students applies.

items: Start the 14-day trial, connect your domain and upload one complete course, ideally a new or extended version of your best Udemy course.
Leave your Udemy courses live so learners there keep their access and new ones can still find you.
Send your own audience to your academy
Link your own website and app from YouTube, Instagram and WhatsApp, with rupee prices and UPI checkout.
Set your academy's earnings next to your Udemy statement and decide where to put new courses.

faq: What is the best Udemy alternative for Indian instructors?

For most instructors, the best alternative is their own academy run alongside Udemy. AllCoaching fits instructors who want their own website, Android app (iOS app on Pro and Scale) and UPI checkout in rupees, from ₹6,999 a year plus a fee on sales. Learnyst suits test-heavy academies, Exly suits coaches selling sessions, and Graphy suits creators with an audience.
How much does Udemy pay instructors?

Udemy's instructor revenue share is set by its own terms. Its official revenue-share page could not be retrieved on 24 Oct 2026, so we do not quote a percentage here. Read it on Udemy's support site before you compare.
Udemy's terms decide what student information you receive and how you may contact learners; check them directly. On your own academy, the student list belongs to you and you can export it.
Can I set my own price instead of marketplace pricing?
Yes, on your own academy you set every price and discount yourself. On Udemy, pricing works within Udemy's own rules, so read its pricing and promotions policy for instructors.
Will I lose discovery if I leave Udemy?

If you leave completely, you lose Udemy's built-in audience, so most instructors keep Udemy and add their own academy. AllCoaching also lists your courses on its marketplace app, which helps discovery, but it does not replace Udemy's global reach.
Can I move my Udemy course to my own academy?
You can upload your own course videos and notes to your academy. Check Udemy's instructor terms on exclusivity and on promoting outside Udemy before you publish the same course in both places.
Is AllCoaching only for exam coaching?

No. Exam educators (NEET, JEE, SSC, banking, UPSC) and skill instructors (spoken English, coding, yoga, music, marketing) can both use the same tools: courses, tests, notes, unlimited live classes and their own app.
How long does it take to start my own academy?
You can start the 14-day free trial, connect your domain and upload a first course on the same day. Allow a few weeks to move your own audience to it while Udemy keeps running.
